lines.dialogue: Go, Manny, go! Kick it! Don't let him -- kick it!
He tripped him! Where's the penalty?!
Get the ball, Manny! Stop him. You can do it!
You want to take him out?! How about I take you out?!
Why don't you worry about your son? He spend the first half with his hand in his pants.

We're very different. Jay is from the city, he has a big business, I come from a small village, very poor but very, very beautiful. It is the number one village in all of Colombia for the... what's the word?
Yes, the murders. PASSENGER #1 She's adorable.
You're not quitting. You would have stopped that goal if you were staring at that girl again.
Yay, will you talk to him?
What?
What he say?
I don't care where it is, if someone say something about my family --
Like you do, you mean.
Manny, she's sixteen.
Where are you--

Manny is very passionate, like his father. My first husband was very handsome, but too emotional. It seemed like all we ever do was fight and make love, fight and make love. One day, I'm not joking, we fell out the window together.
What is that?
Please, don't do a torture on my language.
I'm trying to have an unexpressed emotion.

I'll just say this: You could learn from Manny. He doesn't keep how he feels inside, and it may not work out for him over there today but it will someday. He's not afraid of how he feels, and women like that. He's like a bullfighter.
How can you think that? I would never! How could I when you're so cute?
And if it bothers you and you want to look a little younger, we can get you some hipper clothes. There's a store right there that--
I'm sorry, Niño.
So how was your trip?
Manny! Give it a rest.
Oh, thank you. It's suede, Pheel.
Oh my god, look at the little angel!
I usually wear nothing in a hot tub.
Manny’s father is taking him to Disneyland for a couple days so we are going away to the wine country.
It’s good. He keeps us grounded.

What about the ceiling fan in Manny’s room? JAY Oh, yeah. Just call a guy. GLORIA No, you do it with Manny. It’s important to teach him how to do things for himself. In my culture, men take great pride in physical labor.
That’s very funny. I will share that with my next husband while we are spending your money.

Very big comedy team in Colombia. El Oso was always hitting Salazar with the ladder and things. And sometimes they wear dresses. They make you laugh, but they also make you think. PHIL Luke? You there? LUKE Hey, Dad. PHIL That was pretty fun today, huh. Gettin’ a new bike. LUKE Yeah, it was awesome. PHIL So how’d it go after we split up? Anything you want to share with me? LUKE Not really. PHIL
You can fly toy planes with Jay next time. Today I want you to spend time with Luke.
Because his mother invited you, so you go. Family should be close.
Men need their hobbies. Manny’s father had many hobbies. Like hiking in the desert, or that kind of skiing where they drop you from a... What is it?
Yes. Once, on a dare, he even boxed with an alligator.
Are you sure?
Well, aren’t they like hands?
Manny brought his favorite game to play with Luke.
I should get going. Do you need anything while I’m out shopping?
Alex, why don’t you come shopping with me? Maybe I can find you something you like.
How bad is it?
I mean Phil. PHIL I was in a plane crash.
You never told your son you love him?
Does that mean you don’t love Manny?
Why, so you could fly a plane into his head?
Jay is telling Phil how much he loves him.
Mitchell is right. You get in that hug.
Jay!
Manny, get in there.
Hold still.

lines.scene: INT. JAY & GLORIA'S HOUSE - HALLWAY/MASTER BEDROOM
lines.dialogue: You can’t watch the game. The whole family’s coming over for barbecue.

lines.scene: INT. JAY & GLORIA'S HOUSE - HALLWAY/MASTER BEDROOM
lines.dialogue: So, everyone can watch.

lines.scene: INT. JAY & GLORIA'S HOUSE - HALLWAY/MASTER BEDROOM
lines.dialogue: Javier. Crazy guy. That’s where he gets his fire. MR. BALABAN Okay, you’re...

lines.scene: INT. JAY & GLORIA'S HOUSE - HALLWAY/MASTER BEDROOM
lines.dialogue: Her kid gets his head stuck in the furniture but Manny is the different one?

lines.scene: INT. JAY & GLORIA'S HOUSE - HALLWAY/MASTER BEDROOM
lines.dialogue: I think we should cancel with them for the barbecue.

lines.scene: INT. JAY & GLORIA'S HOUSE - HALLWAY/MASTER BEDROOM
lines.dialogue: I’m not a sweeper. JAY Just promise me you won’t say anything. GLORIA I have nothing to say. If she has a problem with me, she should say it to my face.

lines.scene: INT. JAY & GLORIA'S HOUSE - HALLWAY/MASTER BEDROOM
lines.dialogue: No, it’s about my new family which has never accepted me. PHIL Of course they have. Gloria, look, you’re a very beautiful woman.

lines.scene: INT. JAY & GLORIA'S HOUSE - HALLWAY/MASTER BEDROOM
lines.dialogue: This bracelet? PHIL CLAIRE

lines.scene: INT. JAY & GLORIA'S HOUSE - HALLWAY/MASTER BEDROOM
lines.dialogue: This new dress?
I can’t believe my little boy is going into the fifth grade.
He used to hold onto my finger with his little hands and look at me with those big eyes and-- Mi niño pequiño.
I think he looks very handsome.
Hey. The last thing Manny needs on his first day of school is you undertaking his confidence. JAY I’m sorry, but there’s only two places people should wear ponchos: Niagara Falls and log rides.
You worry too much about all of this. I wear all sorts of daring outfits and people admire them because I do it with confidence.
Jay Pritchett, what is this?
Why was it in your car?
What did you say to him?
You said plenty with your nothing. Manny looks up to you. He respects your opinion.
Manny can take care of himself.
So we should crush his spirit and destroy everything that makes him who he is?
No. We are taking this poncho to Manny at school, because it is important that he knows you support him. And then we’ll get massages, because that sounded good.
We’re doing the right thing.
We’re just bringing Manny his poncho. I’ll get him.
Years from now, Manny will never remember that a few friends teased him, he’ll only remember that his parents support him. That’s the most important thing.
No one, Manny.
In Colombia, Manny went to Pablo Escobar Elementary School. If you got pulled out of class, it was to identify a body.
I have never been more proud of you. I’m sure all the kids will love it.
Break the flute.
The poncho is bad enough, but you add that horrible flute and that weird dance he does when he plays it, he’ll be a laughing stork.
And now you stepped on it!
And what do you think now?
It’s in his blood. His father was a master swordsman. The man was an artist with his sword. The way he wielded that sword would leave you breathless. He was legendary with --
Ai mi Tigre!!!!
Sorry.
Manny wins! Manny wins!
Of course. I was just telling my grandmother how great Manny did today.
No silly. That was happy talk.
Jay likes to make T-shirts for special occasions. Show them.
I love seeing you like this. So proud of Manny.
It’s okay, Papi.
Look, if he doesn’t want to, it’s his decision. JAY The hell it is. GLORIA He shouldn’t be doing something if it makes him so nervous. Manny, I support you.
What?
Because the man is always superior to the woman?!
Uh, uh, uh... so superior, can’t even finish his sentence.
Manny, you say you’re this lover of women, but if you don’t compete with this girl, you show me and all women that you don’t respect us.
Then take back your sword and go fight this girl like a bull.
I can’t hear you.
Who is the bravest?
Yes.
Thank you. Is she your daughter?
Oh, my God! We have to stop him!
So, can we take you and Caroline out for ice cream?
How about now?
